text:
sre-oncall: Notifying channel: we're tracking increased 5xx and 429s for hosted generation routes in eu-west-2 beginning ~14:07 UTC. Root thread for timeline/mitigation. /cc @channel

ops-bot: [ALERT] edge-cache 5xx-rate > 3% (eu-west-2)

raja: I'm seeing a spike of cache revalidation failures when nodes attempt to fetch model shards from artifact-store; many fetches return 404 for the old manifest and clients get 503s. Collecting cache-proxy logs now.

eli: Quick mitigation: enabled strict revalidate (force-fetch) for edge-cache to bypass stale serving and fall back to origin fetch. Also increased artifact-store read concurrency temporarily.

platform-eng: Routing fallback enabled: affected hosted routes are routed to eu-west-1 for short contexts to reduce customer-facing errors. Monitoring shows fallthrough traffic up ~1.2k rps.

raja: Log snippet:
```
2026-06-12T14:09:21Z ERROR cache-proxy: manifest mismatch: requested="m3-alpha" found="m2-stable" path=/models/m3-alpha/shard-4
2026-06-12T14:09:23Z WARN fetcher: origin 404, retry=1 url=https://artifact-store/internal/m3-alpha
2026-06-12T14:10:12Z ERROR api: serve failed: upstream error: cache-miss->origin 503
```

ops-bot: [ACTION] force-revalidate flag toggled by eli at 14:12 UTC across eu-west-2 edge-cache pool.

support: Customer impact: hosted API users in eu-west-2 may see transient generation failures and increased tail latency; Dedicated customers with pinned regional artifacts unaffected. Support queue has 7 new tickets.

platform-eng: Short-term status: 5xx rate dropped from 3.8% -> 0.9% after force-revalidate and artifact-store scaling. Some clients still hit 429s because of origin throttles while caches refill; we added temporary request-rate caps and soft-queueing to smooth traffic.

raja: Root cause hypothesis: a staggered manifest publish left a subset of artifact-store partitions with old manifests while edge caches tried to serve new model names; this produced repeated origin fetches and origin-side throttling. Need a transactional manifest publish or coordinated invalidation.

eli: Commands used:
```
# force revalidate flag
kubectl set env deployment/edge-cache FORCE_REVALIDATE=true -n edge-eu-west-2
kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-cache -n edge-eu-west-2
```

platform-eng: Next actions: 1) reconcile manifest partitions, 2) run a coordinated invalidation + warmup, 3) add preflight to model publish (manifest commit barrier), 4) add origin-side autoscale guard for publish windows.

status-bot: [STATUS PAGE] Draft incident page: https://status.redwood.infra/incidents/2180123456-preview (publishing at 14:30 UTC)

support: Draft customer message: "We observed transient model fetch failures in eu-west-2 causing some hosted requests to fail. We've forced revalidation and scaled artifact-store; normal service expected within 30-60 minutes. We'll follow up with an RCA."

sre-oncall: ETA to normal: ~30-60 minutes while caches refill. Postmortem owner: @raja - please own RCA and remediation. Target postmortem: EOD tomorrow.

platform-eng: Current status: partial mitigation in place; monitoring closely. Will update at 14:30 and when error rate <0.5% for 15m.

ops-bot: [LINKS] Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/edge-cache.md | Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/edge-cache-eu-west-2?orgId=1

sre-oncall: Thanks team. Keep updates concise here. Escalate to PD if we see regression.
